collision_policy.no_bridging: Adjacent context sentences must remain adjacent in original upstream order; an excluded sentence creates a permanent gap.
collision_policy.post_removal_rule: Recheck 128-document and 64-component floors with no replacement source and no backfill after inference.
precedence: whole-document signature collision => remove both documents
collided normalized sentence with at least 20 characters => remove every affected document
at least two distinct collision identities in one document => remove that document
otherwise remove the isolated short sentence from every model-input and lexical-donor role
signatures: compact JSON of original-case integer-row FORM sequence
compact JSON of pinned-tokenizer input IDs for the complete sentence
collision_policy.trigger: equality of any signature across source partitions

joint_component_rule: Each partition must supply at least 64 document-disjoint components after canonical collision removal. Failure stops prescore without model inference.
